package rulefixtures

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for order_by_clause_literals_scattered_across_layers: Raw sort expressions duplicated in handlers and services instead of query helpers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type Order struct {
	ID        int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Status    string `gorm:"column:status"`
	CreatedAt int64  `gorm:"column:created_at"`
}

type OrderHandler struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func (h *OrderHandler) ListOrders(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var orders []Order
	h.db.Order("created_at DESC").Find(&orders)
}

type OrderRepo struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func (repo *OrderRepo) FindAll(ctx context.Context) ([]Order, error) {
	var orders []Order
	err := repo.db.WithContext(ctx).Order("created_at DESC").Find(&orders).Error
	return orders, err
}
